title: Specify the model explicitly (MODEL: Seedance 2.5) along with total duration…
content:
Specify the model explicitly (MODEL: Seedance 2.5) along with total duration, aspect ratio (16:9), and a hard constraint on shot count and length (EXACTLY 2 SHOTS ONLY — EACH SHOT MUST BE 30 SECONDS LONG) to force long continuous takes instead of multiple clips.

Use a character reference image as an exact identity reference and an outfit reference as an exact wardrobe reference, and explicitly list the consistency attributes to preserve (face, hair, skin tone, age, body proportions, outfit, jewelry/accessories) to reduce identity/wardrobe drift across shots.

Add strict continuity instructions between shots (CONTINUE DIRECTLY FROM SHOT 1; same woman/outfit/mask/mansion/lighting/visual style) to maintain environment and lighting consistency across the full video.

Direct camera behavior inside each long take by enumerating specific moves (slow dolly-in, elegant tracking shots, intimate close-ups, brief rack-focus, shallow depth of field, reflections) to get cinematic motion within a single 30-second shot.

Include negative constraints to prevent common failures (no facial morphing, no wardrobe changes, no unexplained location changes, no cartoon/CGI look, no subtitles/on-screen text until final title card) to keep outputs photorealistic and consistent.

es.content:
Especifica el modelo explícitamente (MODEL: Seedance 2.5), junto con la duración total, la relación de aspecto (16:9) y una restricción estricta sobre el número de planos y su duración (EXACTLY 2 SHOTS ONLY — EACH SHOT MUST BE 30 SECONDS LONG) para forzar tomas largas y continuas en lugar de múltiples clips.

Usa una imagen de referencia del personaje como referencia exacta de identidad y una referencia de vestuario como referencia exacta del atuendo, y enumera explícitamente los atributos de consistencia que deben preservarse (rostro, cabello, tono de piel, edad, proporciones corporales, vestuario, joyas/accesorios) para reducir la deriva de identidad/vestuario entre planos.

Añade instrucciones estrictas de continuidad entre planos (CONTINUE DIRECTLY FROM SHOT 1; same woman/outfit/mask/mansion/lighting/visual style) para mantener la consistencia del entorno y la iluminación a lo largo de todo el video.

Dirige el comportamiento de la cámara dentro de cada toma larga enumerando movimientos específicos (slow dolly-in, elegant tracking shots, intimate close-ups, brief rack-focus, shallow depth of field, reflections) para lograr movimiento cinematográfico dentro de un único plano de 30 segundos.

Incluye restricciones negativas para evitar fallos comunes (no facial morphing, no wardrobe changes, no unexplained location changes, no cartoon/CGI look, no subtitles/on-screen text until final title card) para mantener resultados fotorrealistas y consistentes.

fr.content:
Spécifiez explicitement le modèle (MODEL: Seedance 2.5), ainsi que la durée totale, le ratio d’aspect (16:9) et une contrainte stricte sur le nombre de plans et leur durée (EXACTLY 2 SHOTS ONLY — EACH SHOT MUST BE 30 SECONDS LONG) afin d’imposer de longs plans continus plutôt que plusieurs clips.

Utilisez une image de référence du personnage comme référence d’identité exacte et une référence de tenue comme référence vestimentaire exacte, et listez explicitement les attributs de cohérence à préserver (visage, cheveux, teint, âge, proportions du corps, tenue, bijoux/accessoires) afin de réduire la dérive d’identité/de garde-robe d’un plan à l’autre.

Ajoutez des instructions strictes de continuité entre les plans (CONTINUE DIRECTLY FROM SHOT 1; same woman/outfit/mask/mansion/lighting/visual style) afin de maintenir la cohérence de l’environnement et de l’éclairage sur l’ensemble de la vidéo.

Dirigez le comportement de la caméra à l’intérieur de chaque long take en énumérant des mouvements précis (slow dolly-in, elegant tracking shots, intimate close-ups, brief rack-focus, shallow depth of field, reflections) pour obtenir un mouvement cinématographique au sein d’un seul plan de 30 secondes.

Incluez des contraintes négatives pour empêcher les échecs courants (no facial morphing, no wardrobe changes, no unexplained location changes, no cartoon/CGI look, no subtitles/on-screen text until final title card) afin de conserver des résultats photoréalistes et cohérents.

ja.content:
モデルを明示的に指定し（MODEL: Seedance 2.5）、総尺、アスペクト比（16:9）、そしてショット数と長さに関する厳格な制約（EXACTLY 2 SHOTS ONLY — EACH SHOT MUST BE 30 SECONDS LONG）を設定して、複数のクリップではなく長い連続ショットになるようにします。

キャラクター参照画像を正確なアイデンティティ参照として、衣装参照を正確なワードローブ参照として使用し、さらに維持すべき一貫性の属性（顔、髪、肌の色、年齢、体型、衣装、ジュエリー／アクセサリー）を明示的に列挙して、ショット間でのアイデンティティ／衣装のブレを抑えます。

ショット間の厳密な連続性指示（CONTINUE DIRECTLY FROM SHOT 1; same woman/outfit/mask/mansion/lighting/visual style）を追加して、動画全体を通して環境とライティングの一貫性を維持します。

各長回しの中でのカメラの動きを、具体的な動き（slow dolly-in, elegant tracking shots, intimate close-ups, brief rack-focus, shallow depth of field, reflections）として列挙し、1本の30秒ショットの中でシネマティックな動きを実現します。

よくある失敗を防ぐためのネガティブ制約（no facial morphing, no wardrobe changes, no unexplained location changes, no cartoon/CGI look, no subtitles/on-screen text until final title card）を含め、出力がフォトリアルで一貫したものになるようにします。

ko.content:
모델을 명시적으로 지정하세요(MODEL: Seedance 2.5). 또한 총 길이, 화면 비율(16:9), 그리고 샷 수와 길이에 대한 강한 제약(EXACTLY 2 SHOTS ONLY — EACH SHOT MUST BE 30 SECONDS LONG)을 함께 넣어, 여러 클립이 아니라 긴 연속 테이크가 생성되도록 유도합니다.

캐릭터 레퍼런스 이미지는 정확한 정체성 기준으로, 의상 레퍼런스는 정확한 복장 기준으로 사용하세요. 그리고 유지해야 할 일관성 속성(얼굴, 머리카락, 피부 톤, 나이, 신체 비율, 의상, 주얼리/액세서리)을 명시적으로 나열해 샷 간 identity/wardrobe drift를 줄이세요.

샷 사이의 엄격한 연속성 지시를 추가하세요(CONTINUE DIRECTLY FROM SHOT 1; same woman/outfit/mask/mansion/lighting/visual style)하여 전체 영상에서 환경과 조명 일관성을 유지합니다.

각 긴 테이크 안에서 구체적인 카메라 움직임을 열거해 직접 지시하세요(slow dolly-in, elegant tracking shots, intimate close-ups, brief rack-focus, shallow depth of field, reflections). 이렇게 하면 하나의 30초 샷 안에서도 시네마틱한 움직임을 얻을 수 있습니다.

일반적인 실패를 막기 위한 네거티브 제약을 포함하세요(no facial morphing, no wardrobe changes, no unexplained location changes, no cartoon/CGI look, no subtitles/on-screen text until final title card). 이를 통해 결과물이 포토리얼하고 일관되게 유지됩니다.

pt.content:
Especifique o modelo explicitamente (MODEL: Seedance 2.5), juntamente com a duração total, a proporção de aspecto (16:9) e uma restrição rígida no número de takes e na duração (EXACTLY 2 SHOTS ONLY — EACH SHOT MUST BE 30 SECONDS LONG) para forçar takes longos e contínuos em vez de vários clipes.

Use uma imagem de referência do personagem como referência exata de identidade e uma imagem de referência do figurino como referência exata de vestuário, e liste explicitamente os atributos de consistência a serem preservados (face, hair, skin tone, age, body proportions, outfit, jewelry/accessories) para reduzir desvios de identidade/figurino entre os takes.

Adicione instruções rígidas de continuidade entre os takes (CONTINUE DIRECTLY FROM SHOT 1; same woman/outfit/mask/mansion/lighting/visual style) para manter a consistência do ambiente e da iluminação ao longo de todo o vídeo.

Direcione o comportamento da câmera dentro de cada take longo enumerando movimentos específicos (slow dolly-in, elegant tracking shots, intimate close-ups, brief rack-focus, shallow depth of field, reflections) para obter movimento cinematográfico dentro de um único take de 30 segundos.

Inclua restrições negativas para evitar falhas comuns (no facial morphing, no wardrobe changes, no unexplained location changes, no cartoon/CGI look, no subtitles/on-screen text until final title card) para manter os resultados fotorrealistas e consistentes.

zh.content:
明确指定模型（MODEL: Seedance 2.5），同时注明总时长、画幅比例（16:9），以及对镜头数量和时长的硬性限制（EXACTLY 2 SHOTS ONLY — EACH SHOT MUST BE 30 SECONDS LONG），以强制生成长时间连续镜头，而不是多个短片段。

使用角色参考图作为精确的身份参考，并使用服装参考图作为精确的服装参考，同时明确列出需要保持一致的属性（face, hair, skin tone, age, body proportions, outfit, jewelry/accessories），以减少跨镜头的身份/服装漂移。

添加严格的镜头间连续性指令（CONTINUE DIRECTLY FROM SHOT 1; same woman/outfit/mask/mansion/lighting/visual style），以在整个视频中保持环境和光照的一致性。

通过枚举具体运镜方式来直接控制每个长镜头内的 camera 行为（slow dolly-in, elegant tracking shots, intimate close-ups, brief rack-focus, shallow depth of field, reflections），从而在单个 30 秒镜头内获得 cinematic 动感。

加入负面约束以防止常见失败（no facial morphing, no wardrobe changes, no unexplained location changes, no cartoon/CGI look, no subtitles/on-screen text until final title card），以保持输出的 photorealistic 和一致性。
